$comment: Bundled Habitica gear/appearance catalog snapshot for Fingersnap. Numeric item data derived from Habitica content; art is NOT bundled here. Generated from GET https://habitica.com/api/v3/content (public, x-client only).

provenance.name: habitica-content-snapshot
provenance.auth: none (public static content GET; no account credentials used)

licenses.gearData: Item stat definitions derived from Habitica source/content data (GPL v3). See docs/habitica-assets.md.
licenses.art: Habitica/Weirdly Wonderful art is CC BY-NC-SA 3.0 and is NOT bundled in this file; upstream sprite URLs recorded in docs/habitica-assets.md.

provenance.modifications: Flattened to per-key numeric stats; text/notes/i18n strings omitted; no numeric values changed.

$rules.spriteExistence: A sprite name is renderable iff it appears in upstream spritesmith-main.css (png) or constants/gifSprites.js (gif).
$rules.noneValues: hair slot style 0, hair_flower_0, chair none, and *_base_0 / *_<klass>_0 tier pieces are intentional no-visual entries (spritelessGear / style 0) and render no layer.
$rules.armorNaming: armor sprite names are size-prefixed: slim_<key> / broad_<key>. All other gear uses the bare key.
$rules.petMountNaming: pet = 'Pet-'+key; mount = 'Mount_Body_'+key AND 'Mount_Head_'+key; gifSprites entries use .gif, everything else .png.
